calls: CORRECTION: Run 08's 'homegrown Saudi men's luxury has no owner' overstated it. SADF (Rawan Alhadlaq; Italian cashmere and wool; men's, women's, unisex; Saudi 100 Brands; FW26 in Paris, PFW Sept 30) is the first direct entrant. Ground is lightly occupied. Menswear depth and prices unverified.

NEW: luxury sidairi is the clearest product white space in nine runs. Mihyar's adult wool sidairi is SAR 499 list, marked down 50% to SAR 249 (Oct 4). No luxury tier found. Youth revival; wool or velvet in winter.
CONFIRMED: soft construction for SS27 is now Milan + Paris (Dior Men SS27: oversized relaxed tailoring, fluid double-breasted blazers, silk-chiffon pinstripes).

CORRECTION: RFW 'international presence triples' (Run 06) was one magazine forecast, no official number. Official: +90% brand participation over three years. Lineup still unpublished Oct 3; Dubai FW Oct 22-26 stacks right after.

Crowded route added: Saudi heritage reworked for the Paris runway (KML, SADF, Saudi 100). Cucinelli raised FY26 guidance to +10-11% cc. Westfield Riyadh Sept opening unconfirmed. Browser access refused, so no follower recount.
